column1: # Names for CLABLOGO.EXE (the C-Lab logo, Turbo Pascal). Segment 0000 = the program, segment 0051 = the Turbo
# Pascal System unit. 0051:xxxx is linear 510h + xxxx, so some System routines also appear as 0000:07xx aliases.
# Function names from the naming pass of 2026-09-30 (read from the recompiled code).

column4: Main program: copy the jingle into the PMD music buffer (INT 60h AH=06h) and the PPS data into PPSDRV (INT 64h AH=04h), start the music; show the logo with palette fades and the wave effect; clear the screen at the end.

Assign(Text): fill the text file record (mode fmClosed D7B0h, buffer 80h bytes, open function 0356h) and copy the name.
Reset(Text): close the file if open, mode fmInput (D7B1h), call its open function.
Rewrite(Text): close the file if open, mode fmOutput (D7B2h), call its open function.
Close(Text): flush an output file, call its close function, mode fmClosed.
Call the text file function at [DI+BX] (open, in/out, flush, close); keep an error in InOutRes (3E36).

Append: seek to the last 128 bytes and to the Ctrl-Z end mark of the text file.

Text file close function: close the DOS handle when it is above 4.
